# Official Examples

Use these before relying on random blog posts or stale snippets.

## Primary URLs
- Examples index: https://odin-lang.org/docs/examples/
- Official examples repository: https://github.com/odin-lang/examples
- Official demo file page: https://odin-lang.org/docs/demo/
- Upstream demo file: https://github.com/odin-lang/Odin/blob/master/examples/demo/demo.odin

## How to Use Them
- Use the examples index to confirm official entry points for examples.
- Use `odin-lang/examples` for idiomatic end-to-end examples and library usage patterns.
- Use the demo file for dense language-feature examples and quick syntax confirmation.

## Notes
- The official examples repository is intended to show idiomatic Odin usage across `core` and `vendor` packages.
- The examples page explicitly lists both the demo file and the official examples repository.
- Prefer these sources over community snippets when accuracy matters.
